title.raw: 卷3 太宗紀 Volume 3 Annals: Taizong (Emperor Mingyuan)

sentences.zh: 太宗明元皇帝，諱嗣，太祖長子也，母曰劉貴人，登國七年生於雲中宮。

translations.literal: Taizong, Emperor Mingyuan — taboo name Si — was Taizu's eldest son. His mother was Lady Liu. In the seventh year of Dengguo he was born at Yunzhong Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong, Emperor Mingyuan, bore the taboo name Si. He was Taizu's eldest son; his mother was Lady Liu. In the seventh year of Dengguo he was born at Yunzhong Palace.

sentences.zh: 太祖晚有子，聞而大悅，乃大赦天下。

translations.literal: Taizu had a son late in life; when he heard, he was greatly pleased and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu had long been without an heir; when at last a son was born, he rejoiced and granted amnesty to the empire.

sentences.zh: 帝明叡寬毅，非禮不動，太祖甚奇之。

translations.literal: The Emperor was bright, wise, generous, and resolute; he would not act against ritual propriety. Taizu marveled at him greatly.
translations.idiomatic: The boy was bright, wise, magnanimous, and firm; he would not stir except by ritual. Taizu thought him extraordinary.

sentences.zh: 天興六年，封齊王，拜相國，加車騎大將軍。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tianxing he was enfeoffed as Prince of Qi, appointed Chancellor of State, and given the additional title General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Tianxing he was made Prince of Qi, appointed Chancellor of State, and given the additional rank of General of Chariots and Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 初，帝母劉貴人賜死，太祖告帝曰：「昔漢武帝將立其子而殺其母，不令婦人後與國政，使外家為亂。

translations.literal: At first the Emperor's mother Lady Liu was granted death. Taizu told the Emperor: "In former times Emperor Wu of Han was about to establish his son as heir and therefore killed the mother, lest women afterward participate in state affairs and let the maternal kin bring disorder."
translations.idiomatic: Early on, the Emperor's mother Lady Liu was put to death. Taizu told him, "Long ago Emperor Wu of Han, about to set his son on the throne, killed the boy's mother so that no woman might later meddle in government and no maternal clan might sow chaos."

sentences.zh: 汝當繼統，故吾遠同漢武，為長久之計。

translations.literal: "You are to succeed the throne; therefore I follow Emperor Wu of Han from afar as a plan for long-term stability."
translations.idiomatic: "You are to inherit the throne. I have followed Emperor Wu's example from afar, thinking of what must last."

sentences.zh: 」帝素純孝，哀泣不能自勝，太祖怒之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor had always been purely filial; he wept in grief beyond bearing himself. Taizu grew angry at him.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor had always been deeply filial. He wept until he could no longer master himself, and Taizu grew angry.

sentences.zh: 帝還宮，哀不自止，日夜號泣。

translations.literal: The Emperor returned to the palace; his grief would not stop; day and night he wailed and wept.
translations.idiomatic: Back in the palace, his grief would not cease; day and night he mourned aloud.

sentences.zh: 太祖知而又召之。

translations.literal: Taizu learned of it and summoned him again.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu heard of it, he summoned him again.

sentences.zh: 帝欲入，左右曰：「孝子事父，小杖則受，大杖避之。

translations.literal: The Emperor wished to enter; those at his side said: "A filial son serves his father: for a light beating he submits, for a heavy beating he withdraws."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor meant to go in, but his attendants said, "A filial son obeys a light stroke and flees a heavy one."

sentences.zh: 今陛下怒盛，入或不測，陷帝於不義。

translations.literal: Now Your Majesty's anger is at its height; if you enter, harm may be unforeseeable and the Emperor would be trapped in unrighteousness.
translations.idiomatic: "Your father's wrath is at its height. If you go in now, you cannot tell what may happen—and you would put the Son of Heaven in the wrong."

sentences.zh: 不如且出，待怒解而進，不晚也。

translations.literal: Better for the moment to go out; wait until the anger subsides and then advance—it will not be too late.
translations.idiomatic: "Better withdraw for now and return when his anger has cooled. That will not be too late."

sentences.zh: 」帝懼，從之，乃遊行逃於外。

translations.literal: " The Emperor feared; he followed them, and then traveled in flight outside.
translations.idiomatic: Afraid, he took their counsel and went abroad in flight.

sentences.zh: 天賜六年冬十月，清河王紹作逆，太祖崩。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, Tianci year 6: Prince of Qinghe Shao rebelled; Taizu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter in the sixth year of Tianci, Prince of Qinghe Shao rose in rebellion and Taizu died.

sentences.zh: 帝入誅紹。

translations.literal: The Emperor entered and executed Shao.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor entered the capital, put Shao to death, and seized power.

sentences.zh: 壬申，即皇帝位，[2]大赦，改年為永興元年。

translations.literal: On renshen he ascended the imperial throne, [2] general amnesty, changed the era to Yongxing year 1.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day he took the throne, [2] proclaimed a general amnesty, and declared the first year of Yongxing.

sentences.zh: 追尊皇妣為宣穆皇后。

translations.literal: He posthumously honored his imperial mother as Empress Xuanmu.
translations.idiomatic: He raised his late mother to the posthumous title Empress Xuanmu.

sentences.zh: 公卿大臣先罷歸第不與朝政者，悉復登用之。

translations.literal: Dukes and ministers who had earlier been dismissed and sent home, not participating in court affairs, were all restored and employed again.
translations.idiomatic: Every duke and minister who had been sent home and barred from government was recalled to office.

sentences.zh: 詔南平公長孫嵩、北新侯安同對理民訟，簡賢任能，彝倫攸敍。

translations.literal: An edict: Duke of Nanping Changsun Song and Marquis of Beixin An Tong were to judge civil suits, select the worthy and employ the able, so that human relations might be set in order.
translations.idiomatic: He decreed that Changsun Song, Duke of Nanping, and An Tong, Marquis of Beixin, should hear civil cases, choose able men for office, and put the moral order to rights.

sentences.zh: 閏十月丁亥，朱提王悅謀反，賜死。

translations.literal: Intercalary tenth month, day dinghai: Prince of Zhuti Yue plotted rebellion and was granted death.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the intercalary tenth month, Prince of Zhuti Yue plotted rebellion and was ordered to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 詔鄭兵將軍、山陽侯奚斤巡行諸州，[3]問民疾苦，撫恤窮乏。

translations.literal: An edict: General of Zheng Troops, Marquis of Shanyang Xi Jin, was to tour the provinces, [3] inquire into the people's hardships, and comfort and relieve the destitute.
translations.idiomatic: He decreed that Xi Jin, General of Zheng Troops and Marquis of Shanyang, should tour the provinces, [3] ask after the people's hardships, and succor the poor.

sentences.zh: 十有二月戊戌，封衞王儀子良為南陽王，陰平公元烈進爵為王，高涼王樂真改封平陽王。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuxu: Prince of Wei Ziliang, son of the Prince of Wei, was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanyang; Prince of Yinping Yuan Lie was advanced in rank to prince; Prince of Gaoliang Yuezhen was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the twelfth month, Ziliang, son of the Prince of Wei, was made Prince of Nanyang; Yuan Lie, Prince of Yinping, was raised to princely rank; and Yuezhen, Prince of Gaoliang, was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 己亥，帝始居西宮，御天文殿。

translations.literal: On jihai the Emperor first took residence in the Western Palace and held court at the Hall of Heavenly Patterns.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day the Emperor moved into the Western Palace and held court in the Hall of Heavenly Patterns.

sentences.zh: 蠕蠕犯塞。

translations.literal: The Rouran raided the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The Rouran struck the border.

sentences.zh: 是歲，乞伏乾歸據金城自稱秦王。

translations.literal: That year Qifu Qian'gui seized Jincheng and styled himself King of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: That year Qifu Qian'gui seized Jincheng and declared himself King of Qin.

sentences.zh: 高雲為海夷馮跋所滅，跋僭號，自稱大燕天王。

translations.literal: Gao Yun was destroyed by the sea-barbarian Feng Ba; Ba presumptuously took a reign title and styled himself Great Heavenly King of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yun fell to Feng Ba, a lord of the eastern sea; Ba seized the throne and styled himself Great Heavenly King of Yan.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月甲寅朔，詔南平公長孫嵩等北伐蠕蠕。

translations.literal: Year 2, spring, first month, day jiayin, first day of month: an edict that Changsun Song and others should campaign north against the Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the first day of the first month of spring, the jiayin day, he ordered Changsun Song and others to march north against the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 平陽民黃苗等，依汾自固，受姚興官號。

translations.literal: The people of Pingyang, Huang Miao and others, relied on the Fen River to hold firm and accepted office titles from Yao Xing.
translations.idiomatic: At Pingyang, Huang Miao and his band entrenched themselves along the Fen and took commissions from Yao Xing.

sentences.zh: 并州刺史元六頭討平之。

translations.literal: Governor of Bingzhou Yuan Liutou attacked and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Liutou, governor of Bingzhou, attacked and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 二月癸未朔，詔將軍于栗磾領步騎一萬鎮平陽。

translations.literal: Second month, day guiwei, first day of month: an edict that General Yu Lüpi was to lead ten thousand foot and horse to garrison Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the first guiwei day of the second month he ordered General Yu Lüpi to take ten thousand infantry and cavalry to garrison Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，長孫嵩等自大漠還，蠕蠕追圍之於牛川。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month: Changsun Song and others returned from the great desert; the Rouran pursued and besieged them at Niuchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, Changsun Song's column returned from the deep desert; the Rouran pursued and trapped them at Niuchuan.

sentences.zh: 壬申，帝北伐。

translations.literal: On renshen the Emperor campaigned north.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day the Emperor marched north in person.

sentences.zh: 蠕蠕聞而遁走，車駕還幸參合陂。

translations.literal: The Rouran heard and fled; the imperial carriage returned and sojourned at Canhebo.
translations.idiomatic: The Rouran heard and withdrew; the court returned and halted at Canhebo.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳，立馬射臺於陂西，仍講武教戰。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingsi: a horse-shooting platform was set up west of the marsh; military exercises and war drill were still conducted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the dingsi day, a horse-shooting terrace was raised west of the marsh, and troops were drilled for war.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，車駕至自北伐。

translations.literal: On yichou the imperial carriage returned from the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day the court returned from the northern expedition.

sentences.zh: 八月，章武民劉牙聚眾反。

translations.literal: Eighth month: the people of Zhangwu, Liu Ya and others, gathered crowds in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the people of Zhangwu, led by Liu Ya, rose in armed revolt.

sentences.zh: 山陽侯奚斤討平之。

translations.literal: Marquis of Shanyang Xi Jin attacked and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Jin, Marquis of Shanyang, attacked and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，葬太祖宣武皇帝於盛樂金陵。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiayin: Taizu Emperor Xuanwu was buried at Jinling in Shengle.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the ninth month, Taizu Emperor Xuanwu was buried at Jinling in Shengle.

sentences.zh: 冬十有二月辛巳，詔將軍周觀率眾詣西河離石，鎮撫山胡。

translations.literal: Winter, twelfth month, day xinsi: an edict that General Zhou Guan was to lead troops to Xilihe in Xihe and pacify the mountain Hu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on the xinsi day, he ordered General Zhou Guan to march to Xilihe in Xihe and pacify the mountain Hu.

sentences.zh: 是歲，司馬德宗將劉裕，滅慕容超於廣固。

translations.literal: That year Sima Dezong's general Liu Yu destroyed Murong Chao at Guanggu.
translations.idiomatic: That year Liu Yu, general to Sima Dezong, destroyed Murong Chao at Guanggu.

sentences.zh: 三年春二月戊戌，詔曰：「衣食足，知榮辱。

translations.literal: Year 3, spring, second month, day wuxu: an edict said: "When clothing and food are sufficient, one knows honor and shame."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the wuxu day of the second month of spring, an edict declared: "Only when clothing and food are secure do people discern honor from shame."

sentences.zh: 夫人飢寒切己，唯恐朝夕不濟，所急者溫飽而已，何暇及於仁義之事乎？

translations.literal: When hunger and cold press upon a man, he fears only that morning and evening will not be provided for; what he urgently needs is warmth and fullness—how could he spare thought for righteousness and ritual?
translations.idiomatic: "When hunger and cold press close, a man dreads only that he may not eat his next meal or wear his next coat. Warmth and a full belly are all he can seek—how should he spare a thought for benevolence and ritual?"

sentences.zh: 王教之多違，蓋由於此也。

translations.literal: The many violations of royal teaching surely stem from this.
translations.idiomatic: "Much of the empire's defiance of the king's teaching comes of this."

sentences.zh: 非夫耕婦織，內外相成，何以家給人足矣。

translations.literal: Unless the husband plows and the wife weaves, inner and outer cooperating, how can the household be supplied and the people content?
translations.idiomatic: "Unless husbands plow and wives weave, each doing the work within and without the home, how shall families be fed and the people content?"

sentences.zh: 其簡宮人非所當御及執作伎巧，自餘悉出以配鰥民。

translations.literal: Select palace women not fit for the inner quarters and those who perform clever crafts; of the remainder send all out to be matched with widowers.
translations.idiomatic: "Release every palace woman unfit for the inner quarters or kept only for clever crafts; let the rest be given in marriage to men without wives."

sentences.zh: 」己亥，詔北新侯安同等持節循行并、定二州及諸山居雜胡、丁零，問其疾苦，察舉守宰不法；

translations.literal: " On jihai an edict that An Tong and others, bearing credentials, were to tour Bing and Ding provinces and the various mountain-dwelling mixed Hu and Dingling, inquire into their hardships, and investigate and report unlawful prefects and magistrates;
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day he decreed that An Tong and others, bearing the imperial staff, should tour Bing and Ding and the mountain Hu and Dingling settlements, ask after their hardships, and report corrupt officials;

sentences.zh: 其冤窮失職、強弱相陵、孤寒不能自存者，各以事聞。

translations.literal: those wronged and deprived of office, the strong bullying the weak, the orphaned and cold unable to sustain themselves—each was to report the matter according to the case.
translations.idiomatic: and wherever men had been wronged, driven from office, bullied by the strong, or left orphaned and cold without means to live, they were to bring each case before the throne.

sentences.zh: 昌黎、遼東民二千餘家內屬。

translations.literal: More than two thousand households of Changli and Liaodong submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: More than two thousand households from Changli and Liaodong came in submission.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，詔侍臣常帶劍。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiwei: an edict that attendants were always to wear swords.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day of the third month he decreed that court attendants should always wear swords.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊寅，河東蜀民黃思、郭綜等率營部七百餘家內屬。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuyin: the Shu people of Hedong, Huang Si, Guo Zong, and others led more than seven hundred camp households to submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the wuyin day, Huang Si, Guo Zong, and other Shu clansmen of Hedong led more than seven hundred camp households into allegiance.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯，車駕謁金陵於盛樂。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingmao: the imperial carriage visited Jinling at Shengle.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day of the fifth month the court visited Taizu's tomb at Jinling in Shengle.

sentences.zh: 己巳，昌黎王慕容伯兒謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On jisi Prince of Changli Murong Bo'er plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day Murong Bo'er, Prince of Changli, plotted rebellion and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 六月，姚興遣使來聘。

translations.literal: Sixth month: Yao Xing sent envoys on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Yao Xing sent envoys on a friendly mission.

sentences.zh: 西河胡張賢等率營部內附。

translations.literal: The Hu of Xihe, Zhang Xian and others, led camp households to submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xian and other Hu leaders of Xihe brought their camp followers in submission.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，賜衞士酺三日、布帛各有差。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wushen: the guard was granted three days of communal feasting; cloth and silk were given in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the wushen day, the palace guard was granted three days of feasting and gifts of cloth and silk according to rank.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，賜附國大人錦罽衣服各有差。

translations.literal: On xinyou the attached-state chieftains were given brocade robes and felt garments in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day the chieftains of the attached peoples received brocade robes and felt garments, each according to his station.

sentences.zh: 八月戊寅，詔將軍、束州侯尉古真統兵五千，鎮西境太洛城。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuyin: an edict that General, Marquis of Suzhou Wei Guyuan, was to command five thousand troops and garrison Tailuo city on the western frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day of the eighth month he ordered Wei Guyuan, General and Marquis of Suzhou, to take five thousand men and garrison Tailuo on the western border.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月甲戌，[4]蠕蠕斛律宗黨吐觝于等百餘人內屬。

translations.literal: Winter, twelfth month, day jiaxu, [4] more than a hundred men of the Rouran Hulu clan, Tudi and others, submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on the jiaxu day, [4] more than a hundred men of the Rouran Hulu clan, including Tudi, came in submission.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔南平公長孫嵩、任城公嵇拔、白馬侯崔玄伯等坐朝堂，錄決囚徒，務在平當。

translations.literal: On jiawu an edict that Changsun Song, Duke of Nanping, Ji Ba, Duke of Rencheng, Cui Xuanbo, Marquis of Baima, and others were to sit in the court hall, record and decide prisoners, striving for fairness.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day he ordered Changsun Song, Duke of Nanping, Ji Ba, Duke of Rencheng, Cui Xuanbo, Marquis of Baima, and others to sit in the hall of audience, hear criminal cases, and judge with even hand.

sentences.zh: 四年春二月癸未，登虎圈射虎；

translations.literal: Year 4, spring, second month, day guiwei: ascended the tiger pen to shoot tigers;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the guiwei day of the second month of spring, he entered the tiger compound to shoot tigers;

sentences.zh: 賜南平公長孫嵩等布帛各有差。

translations.literal: Changsun Song and others were given cloth and silk in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Changsun Song and the rest received gifts of cloth and silk according to rank.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，宴羣臣於西宮，使各獻直言。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yiwei: he feasted the host of ministers in the Western Palace and had each offer blunt counsel.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the yiwei day, he feasted his ministers in the Western Palace and bade each speak his mind without flattery.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳朔，東巡。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jisi, first day of month: eastern tour.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the first jisi day, he made an eastern progress.

sentences.zh: 置四廂大將，又放十二時，置十二小將。

translations.literal: Four great generals of the side-halls were established; again the twelve hours were released, and twelve lesser generals were established.
translations.idiomatic: He appointed four great generals for the side halls and, dividing the day into twelve watches, twelve lesser generals as well.

sentences.zh: 以山陽侯奚斤、元城侯元屈行左右丞相。

translations.literal: Xi Jin, Marquis of Shanyang, and Yuan Qu, Marquis of Yuancheng, served as left and right chancellors.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Jin, Marquis of Shanyang, and Yuan Qu, Marquis of Yuancheng, served as left and right chancellors.

sentences.zh: 己卯，大獮于石會山。

translations.literal: On jimao a great hunt was held at Mount Shihui.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day he held a great hunt at Mount Shihui.

sentences.zh: 戊子，臨去畿陂觀漁。

translations.literal: On wuzi he came to the Ji marsh to watch the fishing.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day he came to the Ji marsh to watch the fishing.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，至于濡源。

translations.literal: On gengyin he arrived at Ruyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day he reached Ruyuan.

sentences.zh: 西巡，幸北部諸落，賜以繒帛。

translations.literal: Western tour; he visited the various settlements of the northern tribes and gave them silks.
translations.idiomatic: He turned west, visited the settlements of the northern tribes, and bestowed silks.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengxu: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the eighth month the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 壬子，幸西宮，臨板殿，大饗羣臣將吏，以田獵所獲賜之，命民大酺三日。

translations.literal: On renzi he visited the Western Palace, came to the Board Hall, and gave a great feast to the host of ministers, officers, and clerks; the game taken in the hunt was bestowed on them, and the people were ordered to feast for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day he went to the Western Palace and the Board Hall, where he feasted ministers, officers, and clerks and gave them the game of the hunt; the people were ordered to feast for three days.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賜王公以下至宿衞將士布帛各有差。

translations.literal: On yimao dukes, kings, and those below down to the palace guards and commanders were given cloth and silk in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day dukes, princes, and all down to the palace guard received cloth and silk according to rank.

sentences.zh: 冬十有一月乙丑，賜宗室近屬南陽王良已下至於緦麻之親布帛各有差。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day yichou: the imperial clan from Prince of Nanyang Liang and below to those related by the thinnest mourning garb were given cloth and silk in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the yichou day, the imperial clan from Prince of Nanyang Liang down to kinsmen in the remotest degree of mourning received cloth and silk according to station.

sentences.zh: 十有二月丁巳，車駕北巡，至長城而還。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingsi: the imperial carriage toured north, reaching the Great Wall and returning.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the twelfth month the court marched north to the Great Wall and returned.

sentences.zh: 是年，乞伏乾歸為兄子公府所殺，子熾磐立。

translations.literal: That year Qifu Qian'gui was killed by his elder brother's son Gongfu; his son Chipan succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: That year Qifu Qian'gui was killed by his nephew Gongfu; his son Chipan succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 沮渠蒙遜自稱河西王。

translations.literal: Juqu Mengxun styled himself Prince of Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: Juqu Mengxun declared himself Prince of Hexi.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月己巳，大閱，畿內男子十二以上悉集。

translations.literal: Year 5, spring, first month, day jisi: great review; all men within the capital district aged twelve and above were assembled.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the jisi day of the first month of spring, he held a great review: every man of twelve or more within the capital district was mustered.

sentences.zh: 己卯，幸西宮。

translations.literal: On jimao he visited the Western Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day he visited the Western Palace.

sentences.zh: 頞拔大、渠帥四十餘人詣闕奉貢，賜以繒帛錦罽各有差。

translations.literal: More than forty great chiefs and clan leaders of the Eba came to court with tribute and were given silks, brocades, and felt garments in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: More than forty great chiefs and clan leaders of the Eba came to court with tribute and received silks, brocades, and felt garments according to rank.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔諸州六十戶出戎馬一匹。

translations.literal: On yiyou an edict that every sixty households in the provinces were to furnish one war horse.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day he decreed that every sixty households in the provinces should supply one war horse.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，大閱於東郊，部署將帥。

translations.literal: On gengyin a great review was held at the eastern suburb; generals and commanders were deployed.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day he held a great review at the eastern suburb and arrayed his generals.

sentences.zh: 以山陽侯奚斤為前軍，眾三萬，陽平王熙等十二將，各一萬騎；

translations.literal: Xi Jin, Marquis of Shanyang, was made vanguard with thirty thousand men; Prince of Yangping Xi and twelve other generals each had ten thousand horse;
translations.idiomatic: Xi Jin, Marquis of Shanyang, led the vanguard with thirty thousand men; Prince of Yangping Xi and twelve other commanders each led ten thousand horse;

sentences.zh: 帝臨白登，躬自校覽焉。

translations.literal: the Emperor came to Baideng and personally inspected them.
translations.idiomatic: the Emperor came to Baideng and inspected the host in person.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申，賜陽平王熙及諸王、公、侯、將士布帛各有差。

translations.literal: Second month, day wushen: Prince of Yangping Xi and the kings, dukes, marquises, and officers were given cloth and silk in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the second month Prince of Yangping Xi, the princes, dukes, marquises, and officers received cloth and silk according to rank.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，幸高柳川。

translations.literal: On gengxu he visited Gaoliuchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day he went to Gaoliuchuan.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On jiayin the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，穿魚池於北苑。

translations.literal: On guichou a fish pond was dug in the northern park.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day a fish pond was dug in the northern park.

sentences.zh: 庚午，姚興遣使來聘。

translations.literal: On gengwu Yao Xing sent envoys on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day Yao Xing again sent envoys on a friendly mission.

sentences.zh: 詔分遣使者巡求儁逸，其豪門強族為州閭所推者，及有文武才幹、臨疑能決，或有先賢世冑、德行清美、學優義博、可為人師者，各令詣京師，當隨才敍用，以贊庶政。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched envoys to tour and seek outstanding talent: those of powerful clans and great families recommended by their districts, and those with civil and military ability who can decide doubtful cases, or those of former worthies' lineages with pure conduct and beautiful virtue, learned in righteousness and broad in scholarship, fit to be teachers of men—each was to proceed to the capital; offices would be assigned according to ability to assist in government.
translations.idiomatic: He decreed that envoys should tour the realm in search of excellence: men of powerful houses commended by their districts; men of civil or military talent able to settle hard cases; men of eminent lineage, pure conduct, and wide learning fit to teach others—each such man was to come to the capital, where he would be given office according to his gifts.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，河東民薛相率部內屬。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: the people of Hedong, Xue Xiang, led his following to submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Xue Xiang of Hedong brought his following in submission.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上黨民勞聰、士臻羣聚為盜，殺太守令長，相率外奔。

translations.literal: On yisi the people of Shangdang, Lao Cong and Shi Zhen, gathered in bands as bandits, killed the prefect and magistrates, and in succession fled outward.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day Lao Cong and Shi Zhen of Shangdang gathered bands of robbers, killed their prefect and magistrates, and fled beyond the border.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，車駕西巡，詔前軍奚斤等先行，討越勤部於跋那山。

translations.literal: On yimao the imperial carriage toured west; an edict that the vanguard Xi Jin and others were to go ahead and attack the Yueqin tribe at Mount Bana.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day the court turned west and ordered the vanguard Xi Jin and others to march ahead and strike the Yueqin tribe at Mount Bana.

sentences.zh: 夏五月乙亥，行幸雲中舊宮之大室。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day yihai: the progress came to the Great Hall of the old palace at Yunzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on the yihai day, the court came to the Great Hall of the old palace at Yunzhong.

sentences.zh: 丙子，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On bingzi a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day he proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 西河張外、建興王紹，自以所犯罪重，不敢解散。

translations.literal: Zhang Wai of Xihe and Wang Shao of Jianxing, considering their crimes grave, dared not disband.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Wai of Xihe and Wang Shao of Jianxing, knowing their crimes were grave, did not dare lay down their arms.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，遣元城侯元屈等率眾三千鎮并州。

translations.literal: On gengxu Yuan Qu, Marquis of Yuancheng, and others were dispatched to lead three thousand troops to garrison Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day Yuan Qu, Marquis of Yuancheng, and others were sent with three thousand men to garrison Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔會稽公劉潔、永安侯魏勤等率眾三千鎮西河。

translations.literal: On yimao an edict that Liu Jie, Duke of Kuaiji, Wei Qin, Marquis of Yong'an, and others were to lead three thousand troops to garrison Xihe.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day he ordered Liu Jie, Duke of Kuaiji, Wei Qin, Marquis of Yong'an, and others to take three thousand men to garrison Xihe.

sentences.zh: 六月，西幸五原，校獵于骨羅山，獲獸十萬。

translations.literal: Sixth month: western progress to Wuyuan; hunted at Mount Guluo and took a hundred thousand head of game.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he marched west to Wuyuan, hunted at Mount Guluo, and took a hundred thousand head of game.

sentences.zh: 濩澤劉逸自號征東將軍、三巴王，王紹為署置官屬，攻逼建興郡。

translations.literal: Liu Yi of Huoze styled himself General Who Conquers the East and King of Sanba; Wang Shao was appointed to set up officials; they attacked and pressed Jianxing commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yi of Huoze declared himself General Who Conquers the East and King of Sanba; Wang Shao was made to appoint officials; together they besieged Jianxing commandery.

sentences.zh: 元屈等討平之。

translations.literal: Yuan Qu and others attacked and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Qu and the others attacked and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，還幸薄山。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jisi: returned to visit Mount Bo.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jisi day, the court returned to Mount Bo.

sentences.zh: 帝登觀太祖遊幸刻石頌德之處，乃於其旁起石壇而薦饗焉。

translations.literal: The Emperor ascended to view the place where Taizu on his tours had carved stone praising virtue; he then raised a stone altar beside it and offered sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor climbed to the spot where Taizu had carved stone in praise of his own virtue on earlier tours; beside it he built a stone altar and made offerings.

sentences.zh: 賜從者大酺於山下。

translations.literal: He granted a great communal feast to his followers at the foot of the mountain.
translations.idiomatic: He gave a great feast to those who had accompanied him at the foot of the mountain.

sentences.zh: 奚斤等破越勤倍泥部落於跋那山西，獲馬五萬匹，牛二十萬頭，徙二萬餘家於大寧，計口受田。

translations.literal: Xi Jin and others defeated the Yueqin Beini tribe west of Mount Bana, took fifty thousand horses and two hundred thousand cattle, and moved more than twenty thousand households to Daning, allotting fields by head count.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Jin and others routed the Yueqin Beini west of Mount Bana, seized fifty thousand horses and two hundred thousand head of cattle, and resettled more than twenty thousand households in Daning, granting land by the head.

sentences.zh: 河西胡曹龍、張大頭等，各領部，擁眾二萬人，來入蒲子，逼脅張外於研子壘。

translations.literal: The Hedong Hu Cao Long and Zhang Datou, each leading their divisions, mustered twenty thousand men, entered Puzi, and pressured Zhang Wai at Yanzhi Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Long and Zhang Datou, Hu chiefs of the west, each at the head of his band, gathered twenty thousand men, entered Puzi, and besieged Zhang Wai at Yanzhi Fort.

sentences.zh: 外懼，給以牛酒，殺馬盟誓，推龍為大單于，奉美女良馬於龍。

translations.literal: Wai in fear gave cattle and wine, killed a horse for the oath, raised Long as Great Chanyu, and presented Long with beautiful women and fine horses.
translations.idiomatic: Terrified, Wai sent cattle and wine, slew a horse to seal the pact, proclaimed Long Great Chanyu, and sent him women and fine horses.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，車駕自大室西南巡諸部落，賜其渠帥繒帛各有差。

translations.literal: On bingxu the imperial carriage from Dashe southwest toured the tribes, granting their chiefs silk in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day the court left Dashe and toured the tribes to the southwest, rewarding their chiefs with silk according to rank.

sentences.zh: 遂南次定襄大落城，東踰十嶺山，田於善無川。

translations.literal: Then south he halted at Dingxiang Daluo City, crossed east over Mount Shiling, and hunted at the Shangwu River.
translations.idiomatic: He then halted south at Dingxiang Daluo City, crossed east over Mount Shiling, and hunted along the Shangwu River.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guimao: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the guimao day, the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，奚斤等班師。

translations.literal: On guichou Xi Jin and others returned the army.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day Xi Jin and the others led the army home.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，帝臨白登，觀降民，數軍實。

translations.literal: On jiayin the Emperor went to Baideng, inspected the surrendered people, and counted military stores.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day the Emperor went to Baideng, reviewed the surrendered populace, and took stock of the army's supplies.

sentences.zh: 曹龍降，執送張外，斬之。

translations.literal: Cao Long submitted; he was seized and sent to Zhang Wai, who executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Long surrendered; he was bound and sent to Zhang Wai, who put him to death.

sentences.zh: 辛未，賜征還將士牛、馬、奴婢各有差。

translations.literal: On xinwei he granted cattle, horses, and slaves to the returned campaign troops in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day he rewarded the returning soldiers with cattle, horses, and slaves according to merit.

sentences.zh: 置新民於大寧川，給農器，計口受田。

translations.literal: New subjects were settled in the Daning River valley, given farm tools, and allotted fields by head count.
translations.idiomatic: New settlers were placed along the Daning River, given farm tools, and granted fields by the head.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，幸犲山宮。

translations.literal: On dingchou he visited Mount Shi Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day he went to Mount Shi Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸未，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On guiwei the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁巳，將軍元屈、會稽公劉潔、永安侯魏勤等，擊吐京叛胡，失利，潔被傷，勤死之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingsi: General Yuan Qu, Duke of Kuaiji Liu Jie, Marquis of Yong'an Wei Qin, and others attacked rebellious Hu at Tujing, were defeated; Jie was wounded and Qin died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dingsi day, Yuan Qu, Liu Jie Duke of Kuaiji, Wei Qin Marquis of Yong'an, and others struck the rebel Hu at Tujing and were beaten; Jie was wounded and Qin was killed.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸酉，大饗于西宮。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guiyou: grand feast in the Western Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the guiyou day, a grand feast was held in the Western Palace.

sentences.zh: 姚興遣使朝貢，來請進女，帝許之。

translations.literal: Yao Xing sent envoys with tribute, requesting to send a daughter in marriage; the Emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing sent envoys with tribute and asked to send a princess; the Emperor consented.

sentences.zh: 夏五月辛酉，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day xinyou: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on the xinyou day, the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 六月，司馬德宗冠軍將軍、太山太守劉研弟，輔國將軍、領東平太守陽平趙鸞，廣威將軍、平昌太守羅卓，斗城屠各帥張文興等，率流民七千餘家內屬。

translations.literal: Sixth month: Champion General of Sima Dezong Liu Yan the younger brother, Assistant State General and Administrator of Dongping Yangping Zhao Luan, General of Broad Prestige and Administrator of Pingchang Luo Zhuo, the Tujue bandit chief of Doucheng Zhang Wenshing, and others led more than seven thousand refugee households to submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Liu Yan, younger brother of Sima Dezong's Champion General and Taishan prefect; Zhao Luan of Yangping, Assistant State General and acting Administrator of Dongping; Luo Zhuo, General of Broad Prestige and Administrator of Pingchang; Zhang Wenshing, Tujue chief of Doucheng; and others brought more than seven thousand refugee households in submission.

sentences.zh: 河西胡酋劉遮、劉退孤率部落等萬餘家，渡河內屬。

translations.literal: The Hedong Hu chiefs Liu Zhe and Liu Tuigu led their tribes, more than ten thousand households, to cross the river and submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: The Hu chiefs Liu Zhe and Liu Tuigu led more than ten thousand households across the river to submit.

sentences.zh: 戊申，幸犲山宮。

translations.literal: On wushen he visited Mount Shi Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day he went to Mount Shi Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On dinghai the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 秋八月戊子，詔馬邑侯元陋孫使於姚興。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day wuzi: an edict that Marquis of Mayi Yuan Ousun was to go on mission to Yao Xing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the wuzi day, he ordered Yuan Ousun, Marquis of Mayi, to go on embassy to Yao Xing.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，遣謁者悅力延撫慰蠕蠕，于什門招諭馮跋。

translations.literal: On xinchou he dispatched the Attendant Yueli Yan to comfort the Rouran and Yushimen to summon Feng Ba to allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day he sent the Attendant Yueli Yan to reassure the Rouran and Yushimen to win Feng Ba over by persuasion.

sentences.zh: 詔平南將軍、相州刺史尉古真與司馬德宗太尉劉裕相聞，[5]使博士王諒假平南參軍將命焉。

translations.literal: An edict that General Who Pacifies the South and Governor of Xiangzhou Wei Guzhen was to communicate with Sima Dezong's Grand Marshal Liu Yu, [5] and the Academician Wang Liang was to go as acting Pacify-the-South staff officer bearing credentials.
translations.idiomatic: He decreed that Wei Guzhen, General Who Pacifies the South and governor of Xiangzhou, should open relations with Liu Yu, Grand Marshal of Sima Dezong, [5] and that the Academician Wang Liang should go as acting staff officer of the Pacify-the-South command with credentials.

sentences.zh: 姚興遣使來聘。

translations.literal: Yao Xing sent envoys on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing again sent envoys on a friendly mission.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月壬午，詔使者巡行諸州，校閱守宰資財，非自家所齎，悉簿為贓。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day renwu: an edict that envoys were to tour the provinces, examine the assets of prefects and magistrates, and register as illicit anything not brought from their own households.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the renwu day, he ordered envoys to tour the provinces, audit the wealth of prefects and magistrates, and book as bribery anything not brought from home.

sentences.zh: 詔守宰不如法，聽民詣闕告言之。

translations.literal: An edict: if prefects and magistrates did not follow the law, the people were permitted to go to the capital and accuse them.
translations.idiomatic: He decreed that where a prefect or magistrate broke the law, the people might travel to the capital and lodge complaint.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌朔，蠕蠕犯塞。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, first day bingxu: the Rouran raided the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On the first bingxu day of the twelfth month the Rouran struck the border.

sentences.zh: 丙申，帝北伐蠕蠕。

translations.literal: On bingshen the Emperor campaigned north against the Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day the Emperor marched north against the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 河內人司馬順宰自號晉王。

translations.literal: A man of Henei, Sima Shunzai, styled himself King of Jin.
translations.idiomatic: In Henei, Sima Shunzai declared himself King of Jin.

sentences.zh: 太守討捕不獲。

translations.literal: The prefect pursued and captured him but did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: The prefect hunted him but could not take him.

sentences.zh: 是歲，禿髮傉檀為乞伏熾磐所滅。

translations.literal: That year Tufa Rutan was destroyed by Qifu Chipan.
translations.idiomatic: That year Tufa Rutan was overthrown by Qifu Chipan.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丙辰，車駕至自北伐，賜從征將士布帛各有差。

translations.literal: Year 2, spring, first month, day bingchen: the imperial carriage returned from the northern campaign and granted cloth and silk to the campaign troops in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the bingchen day of the first month of spring, the court returned from the northern expedition and rewarded the soldiers with cloth and silk according to rank.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，大饗于西宮，賜附國大、渠帥朝歲首者繒帛金罽各有差。

translations.literal: Second month, day dinghai: grand feast in the Western Palace; great and lesser chiefs of submitted states who came for the New Year were granted silk, cloth, gold, and felt in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the second month a grand feast was held in the Western Palace, and the great and lesser chiefs of submitted peoples who had come for the New Year received silk, cloth, gold, and felt according to rank.

sentences.zh: 司馬德宗琅邪太守劉朗，率二千餘家內屬。

translations.literal: Sima Dezong's Administrator of Langye Liu Lang led more than two thousand households to submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Lang, Administrator of Langye under Sima Dezong, brought more than two thousand households in submission.

sentences.zh: 庚子，河西胡劉雲等，率數萬戶內附。

translations.literal: On gengzi the Hedong Hu Liu Yun and others led tens of thousands of households to submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day Liu Yun of the Hedong Hu and others led tens of thousands of households in submission.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，立太祖廟於白登之西。

translations.literal: On jiachen Taizu's temple was established west of Baideng.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Taizu's temple was founded west of Baideng.

sentences.zh: 三月，詔曰：「刺史守宰，率多逋慢，前後怠惰，數加督罰，猶不悛改。

translations.literal: Third month, an edict: "Prefects and magistrates for the most part are remiss and slow; repeatedly they have been idle and negligent, and though punished many times they still do not reform.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he decreed, "Prefects and magistrates are for the most part slack; time and again they neglect their duties, and though fined repeatedly they will not mend their ways.

sentences.zh: 今年貲調懸違者，謫出家財充之，不聽徵發於民。

translations.literal: Those who this year are delinquent in tax levies shall pay from their household wealth to make it up; levies on the people are not permitted."
translations.idiomatic: "Whoever falls short on this year's taxes must make good the deficit from his own estate; nothing may be exacted from the people."

sentences.zh: 」河西飢胡屯聚上黨，推白亞栗斯為盟主，號大將軍，反於上黨，自號單于，稱建平元年，以司馬順宰為之謀主。

translations.literal: Starving Hu of the west bank gathered in Shangdang, made Bai Yalis the covenant leader, styled him Grand General, rebelled in Shangdang, styled themselves Chanyu, called the era Jianping year 1, and took Sima Shunzai as their strategist.
translations.idiomatic: Starving Hu from the west gathered in Shangdang, set up Bai Yalis as chief of the covenant, styled him Grand General, rose in rebellion, called themselves Chanyu, dated the era Jianping year 1, and made Sima Shunzai their counselor.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，詔將軍公孫表等五將討之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: an edict that Generals Gongsun Biao and four other commanders were to campaign against them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer he ordered Gongsun Biao and four other generals to campaign against them.

sentences.zh: 河南流民二千餘家內屬。

translations.literal: More than two thousand refugee households of Henan submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: More than two thousand refugee households from Henan came in submission.

sentences.zh: 眾廢栗斯而立劉虎，號率善王。

translations.literal: The masses deposed Yalis and set up Liu Hu, styling him King Who Leads in Goodness.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels deposed Yalis and raised Liu Hu, styling him King Who Leads in Goodness.

sentences.zh: 司馬德宗遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Sima Dezong sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Dezong sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 己卯，車駕北巡。

translations.literal: On jimao the imperial carriage toured north.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao day the court turned north on tour.

sentences.zh: 五月丁亥，次於參合東，幸大寧。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dinghai: halted east of Canhe and visited Daning.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the fifth month he halted east of Canhe and went to Daning.

sentences.zh: 丁未，田于四岬山。

translations.literal: On dingwei he hunted at Mount Siyi.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day he hunted at Mount Siyi.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午，幸去畿陂，觀漁。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuwu: visited Quji Marsh and watched the fishing.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the sixth month he went to Quji Marsh to watch the catch.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，次于濡源，築立蜯臺。

translations.literal: On xinyou he halted at Ruyuan and built the Pang Platform.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day he halted at Ruyuan and raised the Pang Platform.

sentences.zh: [6]射白熊於頹牛山，獲之。

translations.literal: [6] He shot a white bear on Mount Tuiniu and took it.
translations.idiomatic: [6] On Mount Tuiniu he shot a white bear and brought it down.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，幸赤城，親見長老，問民疾苦，復租一年。

translations.literal: On dingmao he visited Chicheng, personally saw the elders, asked after the people's hardships, and remitted one year's rent.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day he went to Chicheng, received the elders in person, asked after the people's hardships, and remitted a year's rent.

sentences.zh: 南次石亭，幸上谷，問百年，訪賢俊，復田租之半。

translations.literal: South he halted at Shiting, visited Shanggu, inquired of centenarians, sought worthy men, and remitted half the field rent.
translations.idiomatic: He halted south at Shiting, visited Shanggu, questioned centenarians, sought out able men, and remitted half the field rent.

sentences.zh: 壬申，幸涿鹿，登橋山，觀溫泉，使使者以太牢祠黃帝廟。

translations.literal: On renshen he visited Zhuolu, ascended Bridge Mountain, viewed the hot springs, and sent an envoy with the great offering to sacrifice at the Yellow Emperor's temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day he came to Zhuolu, climbed Bridge Mountain, viewed the hot springs, and sent an envoy with the great sacrifice to the temple of the Yellow Emperor.

sentences.zh: 至廣寧，登歷山，祭舜廟。

translations.literal: Reaching Guangning, he ascended Mount Li and sacrificed at Shun's temple.
translations.idiomatic: At Guangning he climbed Mount Li and offered at the temple of Shun.

translations.literal: Source annotation [7].
translations.idiomatic: Editorial note [7].

sentences.zh: 秋七月，還宮，復所過田租之半。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: returned to the palace and remitted half the field rent of all places passed through.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn he returned to the palace and remitted half the field rent everywhere he had traveled.

sentences.zh: 九月，

translations.literal: Ninth month,
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month,

translations.literal: 〈lacuna〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈lacuna〉

sentences.zh: 有差。

translations.literal: each in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: each in differing amounts.

sentences.zh: 河南流民，前後三千餘家內屬。

translations.literal: Refugee households of Henan, before and after, more than three thousand in all submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: Refugee households of Henan, more than three thousand in all, came in submission before and after.

sentences.zh: 京師民飢，聽出山東就食。

translations.literal: The people of the capital were hungry; they were permitted to go east of the mountains to find food.
translations.idiomatic: The capital was hungry; the people were allowed to go east of the mountains to find food.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬子，姚興使散騎常侍、東武侯姚敞，尚書姚泰，送其西平公主來，帝以后禮納之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renzi: Yao Xing sent Palace Attendant and Marquis of Dongwu Yao Chang and the Minister Yao Tai to escort the Western Princess; the Emperor received her with empress rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the renzi day, Yao Xing sent his Palace Attendant Yao Chang, Marquis of Dongwu, and Minister Yao Tai to escort the Western Princess; the Emperor welcomed her with the rites due an empress.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，行幸沮洳城。

translations.literal: On xinyou he traveled to Juru City.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day he went to Juru City.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On guihai the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔曰：「古人有言，百姓足則君有餘，未有民富而國貧者也。

translations.literal: On bingyin an edict: "The ancients had a saying: when the hundred clans are sufficient, the ruler has surplus; never yet were the people rich while the state was poor.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day he decreed, "The ancients said that when the people are full, the ruler has surplus; never yet was a rich people paired with a poor state.

sentences.zh: 頃者以來，頻遇霜旱，年穀不登，百姓飢寒不能自存者甚眾，其出布帛倉穀以賑貧窮。

translations.literal: In recent times frost and drought have come repeatedly, the year's grain has not ripened, and very many of the people who cannot support themselves in hunger and cold—let cloth, silk, and grain from the storehouses be issued to relieve the poor."
translations.idiomatic: "Lately frost and drought have followed one upon another, the harvest has failed, and countless people cannot keep themselves from hunger and cold. Issue cloth, silk, and grain from the storehouses to succor the poor."

sentences.zh: 」十有一月丁亥，幸犲山宮。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dinghai: visited Mount Shi Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the dinghai day, he went to Mount Shi Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚子，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On gengzi the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 泰常元年春正月甲申，行幸犲山宮。

translations.literal: Taichang year 1, spring, first month, day jiashen: traveled to Mount Shi Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taichang, on the jiashen day of the first month of spring, he went to Mount Shi Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊子，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On wuzi the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 三月己丑，長樂王處文薨。

translations.literal: Third month, day jichou: Prince of Changle Chuwenz died.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day of the third month Chuwenz, Prince of Changle, died.

sentences.zh: 常山民霍季，自言名載圖讖，持一黑石以為天賜玉印，誑惑聚黨，入山為盜。

translations.literal: A man of Changshan, Huo Ji, claimed his name was in the prophecy charts, held a black stone as a heaven-bestowed jade seal, deluded and gathered a band, entered the mountains as bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Huo Ji of Changshan claimed his name appeared in the prophecy charts, flourished a black stone as a heaven-sent jade seal, rallied a band by deception, and took to the mountains as robbers.

sentences.zh: 州郡捕斬之。

translations.literal: The province and commandery hunted them down and beheaded them.
translations.idiomatic: The province and commandery ran them down and beheaded them.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬子，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renzi: great amnesty; the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the renzi day, he proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the era name.

sentences.zh: 庚申，河間王脩薨。

translations.literal: On gengshen Prince of Hejian Xiu died.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day Xiu, Prince of Hejian, died.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，車駕北巡。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingsi: the imperial carriage toured north.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the sixth month the court turned north on tour.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申，帝自白鹿陂西行，大獮于牛川，登釜山，臨殷繁水而南，觀于九十九泉。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiashen: the Emperor from Bailu Mound traveled west, conducted a great hunt at Niuchuan, ascended Mount Fu, looked south over the Yin-Fan River, and viewed the Ninety-Nine Springs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiashen day, the Emperor left Bailu Mound and went west, held a great hunt at Niuchuan, climbed Mount Fu, looked south over the Yin-Fan River, and gazed upon the Ninety-Nine Springs.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On wuxu the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，前并州刺史叔孫建等大破山胡。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuwu: the former Governor of Bingzhou Shusun Jian and others greatly defeated the Mountain Hu.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the ninth month the former governor of Bingzhou Shusun Jian and others routed the Mountain Hu.

sentences.zh: 劉虎渡河東走，至陳留，為從人所殺，司馬順宰等皆死。

translations.literal: Liu Hu fled east across the river; reaching Chenliu he was killed by his followers, and Sima Shunzai and the rest all died.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Hu fled east across the river; at Chenliu his followers killed him, and Sima Shunzai and the rest perished.

sentences.zh: 司馬德宗相劉裕，泝河伐姚泓，遣其部將王仲德為前鋒，從陸道至梁城。

translations.literal: Sima Dezong's chief minister Liu Yu, going upriver to attack Yao Hong, sent his subordinate general Wang Zhongde as vanguard; by the land route he reached Liangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu, chief minister to Sima Dezong, marched up the river against Yao Hong and sent his lieutenant Wang Zhongde ahead by land as vanguard to Liangcheng.

sentences.zh: 兗州刺史尉建畏懦，棄州北渡，王仲德遂入滑臺。

translations.literal: The Governor of Yanzhou Wei Jian was timid and cowardly, abandoned the province and fled north across the river; Wang Zhongde then entered Huatai.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Jian, governor of Yanzhou, lost heart, abandoned his post, and fled north across the river; Wang Zhongde then took Huatai.

sentences.zh: 詔將軍叔孫建等渡河，耀威滑臺，斬尉建於城下。

translations.literal: An edict that Generals Shusun Jian and others were to cross the river, display might at Huatai, and behead Wei Jian below the walls.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Shusun Jian and the other generals to cross the river, show force at Huatai, and behead Wei Jian beneath the walls.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，幸犲山宮。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renxu: visited Mount Shi Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the renxu day, he went to Mount Shi Palace.

sentences.zh: 徒何部落庫傉官斌先降，後復叛歸馮跋。

translations.literal: The Tujue tribe chief Kuru Guan Bin had first submitted, then rebelled again and returned to Feng Ba.
translations.idiomatic: Kuru Guan Bin of the Tujue tribe had first surrendered, then rebelled again and went over to Feng Ba.

sentences.zh: 驍騎將軍延普渡濡水討擊，大破之，斬斌及馮跋幽州刺史、漁陽公庫傉官昌，征北將軍、關內侯庫傉官提等首，生擒庫傉官女生，縛送京師。

translations.literal: General of Valiant Cavalry Yan Pu crossed the Ru River to pursue and attack, routed them greatly, beheaded Bin and Feng Ba's Governor of Youzhou and Duke of Yuyang Kuru Guan Chang, the Campaign-North General and Marquis Within the Passes Kuru Guan Ti, and others; Kuru Guan Nüsheng was captured alive and bound and sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Pu, General of Valiant Cavalry, crossed the Ru River in pursuit, broke them utterly, and took the heads of Bin, Kuru Guan Chang—Feng Ba's governor of Youzhou and Duke of Yuyang—Kuru Guan Ti, Campaign-North General and Marquis Within the Passes, and others; Kuru Guan Nüsheng was captured alive, bound, and sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 幽州平。

translations.literal: Youzhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou was pacified.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲戌，車駕還宮，築蓬臺於北苑。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiaxu: the imperial carriage returned to the palace and built the Peng Terrace in the northern park.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the eleventh month the court returned to the palace and built the Peng Terrace in the northern park.

sentences.zh: 十二月，南陽王良薨。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Prince of Nanyang Liang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Liang, Prince of Nanyang, died.

sentences.zh: 是歲，姚興卒，子泓立。

translations.literal: That year Yao Xing died; his son Hong succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: That year Yao Xing died and his son Hong succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 二年春二月丙午，詔曰：「九州之民，隔遠京邑，時有壅滯，守宰至不以聞。

translations.literal: Year 2, spring, second month, day bingwu, an edict: "The people of the Nine Provinces are far from the capital; at times matters are blocked and delayed, and the prefects and magistrates do not report them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the bingwu day of the second month of spring, he decreed, "The people of the Nine Provinces lie far from the capital; petitions are often held up, and prefects and magistrates fail to report them.

sentences.zh: 今東作方興，或有貧窮失農務者。

translations.literal: Now the eastern plowing is about to begin; there may be poor people who have lost their farming duties.
translations.idiomatic: "Spring plowing is at hand, and some among the poor may have missed the season.

sentences.zh: 其遣使者巡行天下，省諸州，觀民風俗，問民疾苦，察守宰治行。

translations.literal: Let envoys be dispatched to tour the realm, inspect all the provinces, observe the people's customs, inquire into the people's hardships, and examine the conduct of prefects and magistrates in governing.
translations.idiomatic: "Send envoys to tour the realm, visit every province, observe local custom, ask after the people's hardships, and review how prefects and magistrates govern.

sentences.zh: 諸有不能自申，皆因以聞。

translations.literal: All who cannot speak for themselves—let everything be reported accordingly."
translations.idiomatic: "Whatever grievance cannot be brought forward on its own, report it to us."

sentences.zh: 」辛酉，司馬德宗滎陽守將傅洪，遣使詣叔孫建，請以虎牢降，求軍赴接；

translations.literal: On xinyou Fu Hong, defending general of Xingyang under Sima Dezong, sent an envoy to Shusun Jian requesting to surrender Hulao and asking that an army be sent to meet him;
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day Fu Hong, garrison commander of Xingyang under Sima Dezong, sent an envoy to Shusun Jian offering to surrender Hulao and begging for troops to receive him;

sentences.zh: 德宗譙王司馬文思遣使王良詣闕上書，請軍討劉裕。

translations.literal: Sima Dezong's Prince of Qiao Sima Wensi sent the envoy Wang Liang to the capital with a memorial requesting troops to campaign against Liu Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Wensi, Prince of Qiao under Sima Dezong, sent Wang Liang to court with a memorial asking for an army to campaign against Liu Yu.

sentences.zh: 詔司徒長孫嵩率諸軍邀擊劉裕，戰於畔城，更有負捷。

translations.literal: An edict that Minister of Works Changsun Song led the armies to intercept Liu Yu; they fought at Pancheng, each side winning and losing in turn.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Changsun Song, Minister of Works, to lead the armies against Liu Yu; at Pancheng they fought, and victory shifted back and forth.

sentences.zh: 帝詔止諸軍，不克。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered the armies to halt; they did not prevail.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor recalled the armies; they could not win.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未，榆山丁零翟蜀率營部遣使通劉裕。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingwei: Zhai Shu of the Yushan Dingling led his camp division and sent envoys to communicate with Liu Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the dingwei day, Zhai Shu of the Yushan Dingling led his camp and sent envoys to Liu Yu.

sentences.zh: 馮跋使人王特兒等通於司馬德宗，章武太守捕特兒等，囚送京師。

translations.literal: Feng Ba sent Wang Te'er and others to communicate with Sima Dezong; the Administrator of Zhangwu captured Te'er and the rest, imprisoned them, and sent them to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Ba sent Wang Te'er and others to Sima Dezong; the prefect of Zhangwu seized them, bound them, and sent them to court.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，幸高柳。

translations.literal: On dingsi he visited Gaoliu.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day he went to Gaoliu.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On renxu the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 五月，汝南民胡譁等萬餘家相率內屬。

translations.literal: Fifth month: more than ten thousand households of the Hu people of Runan, led by Hu Hua and others, submitted inward in a body.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month more than ten thousand households of the Hu of Runan, under Hu Hua and others, came in submission together.

sentences.zh: 乙未，司馬德宗齊郡太守王懿來降。

translations.literal: On yiwei Wang Yi, Administrator of Qi under Sima Dezong, came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day Wang Yi, Administrator of Qi under Sima Dezong, surrendered.

sentences.zh: 車駕西巡，至于雲中，遂濟河，田于大漠。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage toured west as far as Yunzhong, then crossed the river and hunted in the great desert.
translations.idiomatic: The court toured west to Yunzhong, crossed the river, and hunted in the great desert.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，作白臺於城南，高二十丈。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: the White Terrace was built south of the city, twenty zhang high.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn the White Terrace was raised south of the city, twenty zhang high.

sentences.zh: 司馬順之入常山，流言惑眾，稱受天帝命，年二十五應為人君，遂聚黨於封龍山。

translations.literal: Sima Shunzhi entered Changshan, spread rumors to delude the masses, claimed to have received the Heavenly Emperor's command that at age twenty-five he should become ruler, and gathered a band at Mount Fenglong.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Shunzhi entered Changshan, spread sedition, claimed a mandate from the Heavenly Emperor that at twenty-five he should rule, and rallied a band on Mount Fenglong.

sentences.zh: 趙郡大盜趙德執送京師，斬之。

translations.literal: The great bandit Zhao De of Zhao commandery seized him and sent him to the capital; he was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao De, a great outlaw of Zhao commandery, seized him, sent him to the capital, and he was beheaded.

sentences.zh: 八月，劉裕滅姚泓。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Liu Yu destroyed Yao Hong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Liu Yu overthrew Yao Hong.

sentences.zh: 九月癸酉，司馬德宗平西將軍、荊州刺史司馬休之，息譙王文思，章武王子司馬國璠、司馬道賜，輔國將軍溫楷，竟陵內史魯軌，荊州治中韓延之、殷約，平西參軍桓謐、桓璲及桓溫孫道子，勃海刁雍，陳郡袁式等數百人來降。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guiyou: Sima Dezong's General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Jingzhou Sima Xiuzhi, his son the Prince of Qiao Sima Wensi, the Prince of Zhangwu's sons Sima Guofan and Sima Daosi, Assistant State General Wen Kai, Administrator of Jingling Lu Gui, Jingzhou staff officers Han Yanzhi and Yin Yue, Pacify-the-West staff officers Huan Mi and Huan Lin and Huan Wen's grandson Daozi, Bohai Di Yong, Chen commandery Yuan Shi, and several hundred others came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the ninth month Sima Xiuzhi, General Who Pacifies the West and governor of Jingzhou under Sima Dezong; his son Sima Wensi, Prince of Qiao; Sima Guofan and Sima Daosi, sons of the Prince of Zhangwu; Wen Kai, Assistant State General; Lu Gui, administrator of Jingling; Han Yanzhi and Yin Yue, staff officers of Jingzhou; Huan Mi and Huan Lin, staff officers of Pacify-the-West, and Huan Wen's grandson Daozi; Di Yong of Bohai; Yuan Shi of Chen commandery; and several hundred others surrendered.

sentences.zh: 姚泓匈奴鎮將姚成都與弟和都舉鎮來降。

translations.literal: Yao Hong's Xiongnu garrison general Yao Chengdu and his younger brother Hedou led their garrison to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Chengdu, Xiongnu garrison commander of Yao Hong, and his brother Hedou brought their garrison in submission.

sentences.zh: 是年，李暠卒，子歆立，遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Li Gao died; his son Xin succeeded and sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Li Gao died; his son Xin succeeded him and sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丁酉朔，帝自長川詔護高車中郎將薛繁率高車丁零十二部大人眾北略，至弱水，[8]降者二千餘人，獲牛馬二萬餘頭。

translations.literal: Year 3, spring, first month, day dingyou, first of month: the Emperor from Changchuan ordered the Protector of the Gaoche Central Commandant Xue Fancheng to lead the twelve division chiefs of the Gaoche Dingling north on campaign to the Weak Water; [8] more than two thousand submitted, and cattle and horses numbering more than twenty thousand head were taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the first dingyou day of the first month of spring, the Emperor at Changchuan ordered Xue Fancheng, Protector of the Gaoche Central Commandant, to lead the twelve division chiefs of the Gaoche Dingling north to the Weak Water; [8] more than two thousand submitted, and more than twenty thousand head of cattle and horses were taken.

sentences.zh: 河東胡、蜀五千餘家相率內屬。

translations.literal: More than five thousand households of Hedong Hu and Shu submitted inward in a body.
translations.idiomatic: More than five thousand households of the Hu and Shu of Hedong came in submission together.

sentences.zh: 三月，司馬德宗遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Third month: Sima Dezong sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Sima Dezong sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，幸西宮。

translations.literal: On gengxu he visited the Western Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day he went to the Western Palace.

sentences.zh: 以范陽去年水，復其租稅。

translations.literal: Because Fan-yang had flood last year, its rent and taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Because Fan-yang had suffered flood the year before, its rents and taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己巳，徙冀、定、幽三州徒何於京師。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jisi: the Tujue of Ji, Ding, and You provinces were moved to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the fourth month of summer the Tujue of Ji, Ding, and You provinces were resettled at the capital.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，詔叔孫建鎮廣阿。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingwu: an edict that Shusun Jian was to garrison Guang'a.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the fifth month he ordered Shusun Jian to garrison Guang'a.

sentences.zh: 壬子，車駕東巡，至于濡源及甘松。

translations.literal: On renzi the imperial carriage toured east as far as Ruyuan and Gansong.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day the court toured east to Ruyuan and Gansong.

sentences.zh: 遣征東將軍長孫道生、給事黃門侍郎奚觀率精騎二萬襲馮跋，又命驍騎將軍延普自幽州北趨遼西為聲勢，帝自突門嶺待之。

translations.literal: He dispatched Campaign-East General Changsun Daosheng and Palace Attendant Xi Guan to lead twenty thousand elite cavalry to strike Feng Ba, and also ordered General of Valiant Cavalry Yan Pu to hurry north from Youzhou toward Liaoxi as a demonstration; the Emperor himself waited at Tumeng Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Changsun Daosheng, Campaign-East General, and Xi Guan, Palace Attendant, with twenty thousand elite horse to strike Feng Ba, and ordered Yan Pu, General of Valiant Cavalry, to press north from Youzhou toward Liaoxi as a feint while the Emperor waited at Tumeng Ridge.

sentences.zh: 道生至龍城，徙其民萬餘家而還。

translations.literal: Daosheng reached Longcheng, moved more than ten thousand households of its people, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Daosheng reached Longcheng, relocated more than ten thousand households, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，車駕西返。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yiyou: the imperial carriage returned west.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the sixth month the court turned west.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊午，至於京師。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuwu: reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the seventh month of autumn he reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 八月，雁門、河內大雨水，復其租稅。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Yanmen and Henei had great rain and flood; their rent and taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Yanmen and Henei were struck by great rain and flood, and their rents and taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，詔諸州調民租，戶五十石，積於定、相、冀三州。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiayin: an edict that the provinces were to levy the people's rent—fifty shi per household—and store it in Ding, Xiang, and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the ninth month he ordered the provinces to levy fifty shi of grain per household and store it in Ding, Xiang, and Ji.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰，築宮於西苑。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuchen: a palace was built in the western park.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the wuchen day, a palace was built in the western park.

sentences.zh: 是歲，司馬德宗卒，弟德文僭位。

translations.literal: That year Sima Dezong died; his younger brother Dewen usurped the throne.
translations.idiomatic: That year Sima Dezong died and his younger brother Dewen seized the throne.

sentences.zh: 赫連屈丐僭稱皇帝。

translations.literal: Helian Qu'ai presumptuously styled himself emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Helian Qu'ai presumptuously declared himself emperor.

sentences.zh: 四年正月壬辰朔，車駕臨河，大蒐于犢渚。

translations.literal: Year 4, first month, day renchen, first of month: the imperial carriage came to the river and conducted a great hunt at Duzhu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the first renchen day of the first month, the court came to the river and held a great hunt at Duzhu.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On guimao the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 三月癸丑，築宮於蓬臺北。

translations.literal: Third month, day guichou: a palace was built north of the Peng Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the third month a palace was built north of the Peng Terrace.

sentences.zh: 司馬德文寧朔將軍、平陽太守、匈奴護軍薛辯及司馬楚之、司馬順明、司馬道恭，並遣使請降。

translations.literal: Sima Dewen's General Who Pacifies the North, Administrator of Pingyang, and Protector of the Xiongnu Xue Bian, together with Sima Chuzhi, Sima Shunming, and Sima Daogong, each sent envoys requesting surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Bian, General Who Pacifies the North, Administrator of Pingyang, and Protector of the Xiongnu under Sima Dewen, with Sima Chuzhi, Sima Shunming, and Sima Daogong, each sent envoys offering surrender.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰，車駕有事於東廟，遠藩助祭者數百國。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengchen: the imperial carriage performed rites at the Eastern Temple; several hundred submitted states assisted in the sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen day of the fourth month of summer the Emperor sacrificed at the Eastern Temple, with several hundred submitted states assisting at the rites.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，南巡，幸雁門。

translations.literal: On xinsi he toured south and visited Yanmen.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day he turned south and went to Yanmen.

sentences.zh: 賜所過無出今年租賦。

translations.literal: He remitted rent and levies everywhere he passed for the current year.
translations.idiomatic: Everywhere he passed he remitted that year's rent and levies.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅朔，觀漁于灅水。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengyin, first of month: watched fishing at the Juan River.
translations.idiomatic: On the first gengyin day of the fifth month he watched the fishing at the Juan River.

sentences.zh: 己亥，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On jihai the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 復所過一年租賦。

translations.literal: He remitted one year's rent and levies everywhere he had passed.
translations.idiomatic: He remitted a year's rent and levies everywhere he had traveled.

sentences.zh: 六月，司馬德文建威將軍、河西太守、馮翊羌酋党道子遣使內屬。

translations.literal: Sixth month: Sima Dewen's General Who Establishes Might, Administrator of Hexi, and Qiang chief of Fengyi Dang Daozi sent envoys to submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Dang Daozi, General Who Establishes Might, Administrator of Hexi, and Qiang chief of Fengyi under Sima Dewen, sent envoys in submission.

sentences.zh: 秋八月辛未，東巡。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day xinwei: toured east.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the eighth month of autumn he toured east.

sentences.zh: 遣使祭恒岳。

translations.literal: He dispatched envoys to sacrifice at Mount Heng.
translations.idiomatic: He sent envoys to sacrifice at Mount Heng.

sentences.zh: 甲申，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On jiashen the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 所過復一年田租。

translations.literal: He remitted one year's field rent everywhere he had passed.
translations.idiomatic: He remitted a year's field rent everywhere he had passed.

sentences.zh: 九月，築宮於白登山。

translations.literal: Ninth month: a palace was built on Mount Baideng.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month a palace was built on Mount Baideng.

sentences.zh: 冬十有二月癸亥，西巡，至雲中，踰白道，北獵野馬於辱孤山。

translations.literal: Winter, twelfth month, day guihai: toured west to Yunzhong, crossed the White Road, and north hunted wild horses at Mount Rugu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on the guihai day, he toured west to Yunzhong, crossed the White Road, and hunted wild horses north at Mount Rugu.

sentences.zh: 至于黃河，從君子津西渡，大狩於薛林山。

translations.literal: Reaching the Yellow River, he crossed west from Junzi Ford and conducted a great hunt at Mount Xuelin.
translations.idiomatic: At the Yellow River he crossed west from Junzi Ford and held a great hunt at Mount Xuelin.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月丙戌朔，自薛林東還，至于屋竇城，饗勞將士，大酺二日，班禽獸以賜之。

translations.literal: Year 5, spring, first month, day bingxu, first of month: from east of Xuelin he returned to Wudou City, feasted and rewarded the officers and soldiers, held a great communal feast for two days, and distributed birds and beasts as gifts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the first bingxu day of the first month of spring, he returned east from Xuelin to Wudou City, feasted and rewarded the troops, held a great feast for two days, and distributed game in gift.

sentences.zh: 己亥，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On jihai the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌，南陽王意文薨。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingxu: Prince of Nanyang Yiwen died.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day of the third month Yiwen, Prince of Nanyang, died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，河西屠各帥黃大虎、羌酋不蒙娥等遣使內附。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: the Tujue chief Huang Dahu of Hexi, the Qiang chief Bumeng'e, and others sent envoys to submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Huang Dahu, Tujue chief of Hexi, the Qiang chief Bumeng'e, and others sent envoys in submission.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，起灅南宮。

translations.literal: On bingyin the Juan South Palace was begun.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day work began on the Juan South Palace.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，詔曰：「宣武皇帝體道得一，天縱自然，大行大名未盡盛美，[9]非所以光揚洪烈，垂之無窮也。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yiyou, an edict: "Emperor Xuanwu embodied the Way and attained unity; Heaven's endowment was natural. The great conduct and great name have not fully expressed his supreme excellence, [9] and are not sufficient to glorify his vast achievement and hand it down without end.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the fifth month he decreed, "Emperor Xuanwu embodied the Way and held unity; Heaven's gift was his by nature. Yet the great deed and great name have not fully shown his supreme excellence, [9] and are not enough to glorify his vast achievement for all time.

sentences.zh: 今因啟緯圖，始覩尊號，天人之意，煥然著明。

translations.literal: Now, following the opened prophecy charts, we first behold the honored title; the intent of Heaven and man is brilliantly made clear.
translations.idiomatic: "Now, as the prophecy charts open, the honored title stands plain and the will of Heaven and man shines clear.

sentences.zh: 其改『宣』曰『道』，更上尊諡曰道武皇帝，以彰靈命之先啟，聖德之玄同。

translations.literal: Let 'Xuan' be changed to 'Dao,' and let the elevated posthumous title be Emperor Daowu, to manifest the prior opening of the numinous mandate and the mysterious sameness of sage virtue.
translations.idiomatic: "Change 'Xuan' to 'Dao' and raise the posthumous title to Emperor Daowu, to show how the numinous mandate opened first and sage virtue joins Heaven in mystery.

sentences.zh: 告祀郊廟，宣于八表。

translations.literal: Proclaim it in sacrifice at the suburban altars and announce it to the eight directions."
translations.idiomatic: "Proclaim it at the suburban sacrifices and announce it to the eight directions."

sentences.zh: 」庚戌，淮南侯司馬國璠、池陽侯司馬道賜等謀反伏誅。

translations.literal: " On gengxu Marquis of Huainan Sima Guofan, Marquis of Chiyang Sima Daosi, and others plotted rebellion and were executed where they lay.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day Sima Guofan, Marquis of Huainan, Sima Daosi, Marquis of Chiyang, and others plotted rebellion and were executed on the spot.

sentences.zh: 六月丙寅，行幸翳犢山。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingyin: traveled to Mount Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day of the sixth month he went to Mount Yidu.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉，西至于五原。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingyou: west to Wuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the seventh month of autumn he went west to Wuyuan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，幸雲中大室，賜從者大酺。

translations.literal: On dingwei he visited Yunzhong Dashe and granted a great feast to his followers.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day he came to Yunzhong Dashe and gave a great feast to those who had accompanied him.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guihai: the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day of the eighth month the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲午，陰平王烈薨。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day jiawu: Prince of Yinping Lie died.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the intercalary month Lie, Prince of Yinping, died.

sentences.zh: 冬十有一月，詔驍騎將軍延普城乾城。
